title: Refund policy
body:
## Faulty or missing files

If your e-book won't download, won't open, or is missing content, email {{email}} with your order details. We'll send a working file or a full refund.

## Change of mind

Because e-books are delivered instantly, you agree at checkout that the 14-day cancellation period ends once the download starts. If you bought the wrong title by mistake and haven't downloaded it, get in touch and we'll do our best to help.

## Other retailers

For books bought from Amazon, Kobo or Google Play, please contact that retailer, as their refund rules apply.
